# yt-insights

Local-first YouTube corpus, timestamped FTS5 search, resumable cumulative
research, deterministic evidence dossiers, optional LLM analysis, and a
four-tool read-only MCP server. A packaged Astro interface exposes the local
dashboard, search, sources, research workflow, jobs, and exports on loopback.

Repository: https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/youtube-video-insights
Package version: 0.2.0
Python: 3.11+
Primary CLI: `yt-insights`
Optional MCP entrypoint: `yt-insights-mcp`

## Product boundary

- The source text is YouTube VTT subtitles. The runtime does not transcribe audio.
- Local assessment never calls YouTube or an LLM.
- Every assessment asks whether evidence is sufficient.
- `refresh` authorizes metadata discovery only.
- Discovery returns at most 10 candidates.
- Acquisition requires a separate approval for 1 to 5 exact candidate IDs.
- Acquired sources trigger one catalogue and FTS refresh, then reassessment.
- Dossiers are deterministic outputs and never become source passages.
- The MCP remains read-only and exposes exactly four tools.

## Four data layers

1. VTT and metadata files: immutable source text, timestamps, and YouTube identity.
2. `catalog.sqlite3`: source inventory, memberships, artifacts, runs, and errors.
3. `.search/search-v1.sqlite3`: derived FTS5 passages and timestamped URLs.
4. `.research/research-v1.sqlite3`: sessions, assessments, decisions, candidates,
   acquisition attempts, outcomes, and events.

Tracked or copied `dossier.md` and `manifest.json` files are publications, not a
fifth source layer.

## Cumulative research commands

```text
yt-insights research start TOPIC [--query QUERY]... [--lang LANG]... [--freshness-profile fast|standard|stable|historical] [--json]
yt-insights research status SESSION_ID [--json]  # latest 100 acquisition attempts, with truncation flag
yt-insights research decide SESSION_ID sufficient|refresh --revision N --idempotency-key KEY [--json]
yt-insights research discover SESSION_ID --revision N [--json]
yt-insights research candidates SESSION_ID [--json]
yt-insights research approve SESSION_ID VIDEO_ID... --revision N --idempotency-key KEY [--json]
yt-insights research cancel SESSION_ID --revision N --idempotency-key KEY [--json]
yt-insights research acquire SESSION_ID --revision N --idempotency-key KEY [--lang LANG] [--json]
yt-insights research retry SESSION_ID --revision N --idempotency-key KEY [--json]
yt-insights research export SESSION_ID [--output ABSOLUTE_DIRECTORY] [--force] [--json]
```

Use the latest returned revision for each mutation. Reuse an idempotency key
only for the exact same request payload. Status exposes `acquisition_history`
for the latest 100 attempts and
`acquisition_history_truncated`. Each attempt has `attempt_id`, `status`, and
`items`; each item has `video_id`, `status`, `error_code`, and `source_sha256`.
It excludes idempotency keys, cookie selectors, transcripts, and raw
diagnostics. Partial-batch retry resumes only items recorded as
`failed_retryable`; it does not reacquire recorded terminal outcomes.

## Other stable commands

- `yt-insights doctor --json`: secret-safe no-write diagnostics.
- `yt-insights acquire SOURCE --dry-run --json`: preview acquisition.
- `yt-insights acquire SOURCE --yes`: confirm a channel, playlist, or batch.
- `yt-insights export video VIDEO_ID --format vtt|txt|md`: deterministic source export.
- `yt-insights index --all`: build the full timestamped FTS index.
- `yt-insights index --status`: validate the configured index.
- `yt-insights search QUERY --limit 1..20 --json`: search timestamped passages.
- `yt-insights catalog import-corpus ROOT`: rebuild the inventory catalogue.
- `yt-insights serve [--no-open]`: run the packaged local interface on
  `127.0.0.1` without a Node.js runtime.
- `yt-insights setup assistants --assets-only --dry-run|--apply|--verify`: manage
  repository skills and native agents without MCP access.

## Research modules

- `src/yt_insights/research/models.py`: immutable enums, values, fingerprints,
  assessments, sessions, candidates, attempts, and event models.
- `src/yt_insights/research/store.py`: schema v1, revisions, idempotence,
  transitions, history, attempts, outcomes, and retry state.
- `src/yt_insights/research/assessment.py`: bounded local catalogue and passage
  reads with before/after database-generation checks.
- `src/yt_insights/research/discovery.py`: provider protocol, yt-dlp metadata
  discovery, deduplication, known-ID exclusion, and channel diversity.
- `src/yt_insights/research/acquisition.py`: exact candidate-to-acquisition
  adapter with structured outcomes.
- `src/yt_insights/research/workflow.py`: application state machine.
- `src/yt_insights/research/dossier.py`: deterministic and path-safe dossier
  publication.
- `src/yt_insights/cli_research.py`: Click and stable JSON adapter.

## Existing modules

- `src/yt_insights/acquisition.py`: preview, acquisition, structured item
  reports, and atomic catalogue/search pair publication.
- `src/yt_insights/catalog.py`: local SQLite inventory.
- `src/yt_insights/search/`: timestamped FTS5 indexing and search.
- `src/yt_insights/exporter.py`: source transcript exports.
- `src/yt_insights/mcp_server.py`: four-tool read-only MCP facade.
- `src/yt_insights/assistant_setup.py`: transactional assistant asset and MCP setup.
- `src/yt_insights/web/`: bounded read models, versioned local API, guarded
  loopback server, mutation jobs, and packaged Astro assets.
- `src/yt_insights/backends/`: optional Ollama, MLX, cc-bridge, Anthropic, and
  OpenAI-compatible analysis backends.

## Configuration

- `data_root`: corpus root.
- `research_output_root`: optional absolute canonical dossier root.
- `YT_INSIGHTS_DATA_ROOT`: environment override.
- `YT_INSIGHTS_RESEARCH_OUTPUT_ROOT`: dossier-root override.
- `YT_INSIGHTS_SEARCH_DATABASE` and `YT_INSIGHTS_CATALOG_DATABASE`: explicit MCP
  database overrides.

The CLI never infers a dossier repository from the current working directory.
An omitted `research_output_root` requires `research export --output`.

## MCP contract

Exactly four tools, in order:

1. `list_corpora`
2. `search_videos`
3. `search_passages`
4. `get_passage`

The MCP does not mutate research state, acquire sources, rebuild indexes, write
exports, expose SQL, or invoke a shell.

## Assistant contract

Portable skills:

- `youtube-acquire`
- `youtube-research`
- `youtube-export`
- `youtube-cumulative-research`

The cumulative skill runs in the main session, interprets
`required_user_action`, and asks before discovery and candidate acquisition.
The cumulative skill instructions and all copy-ready prompts are English. The
three legacy skill frontmatter files retain French trigger phrases.

The repository and wheel contain the fourth skill. It is not globally active.
The fresh project-local Codex canary is `PASS`. The fresh Claude Code canary
remains `UNKNOWN` because the installed CLI is not authenticated.

- relevance pilot: `UNKNOWN`; representative packet returned 0 results, so 0
  of the required 20 human judgments exist.
- discovery probe: `PASS`; 3 subjects, 10 candidates each, no local-state write.
- refresh performance: `PASS`; 5 builds, p95 `47.122951 s`, 3,332 documents,
  184,636 passages.
- live final YouTube workflow: `UNKNOWN`.
- fresh Claude Code workflow: `UNKNOWN`.
- fresh project-local Codex workflow: `PASS`; global installation is not
  claimed.
- global activation: `false`.
- local quality: `PASS`; 1,089 Python tests plus 10 subtests, 155 frontend
  tests, 4 Playwright flows, full Ruff, Astro Check on 51 files, Mypy on 53

- GitHub CI hosted execution: `PASS` on `b62adaa`; run 33494963306 passed the
  web, Python 3.11, Python 3.12, and packaging/runtime jobs:
  https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/youtube-video-insights/actions/runs/33494963306

Mypy was run as `mypy src`; do not claim `mypy --strict` passes.

## Verification

```text
python scripts/verify_web_build.py
pnpm --dir web test
pnpm --dir web check
pnpm --dir web test:e2e
uv run --extra mcp --extra dev pytest -q
uv run --extra dev ruff check src tests scripts
uv run --extra dev mypy src
uv lock --check
.venv/bin/python scripts/smoke_wheel.py --offline
git diff --check
```

These commands pass locally on `b62adaa`. Hosted run 33494963306 validates the
same SHA. None of these checks prove live YouTube or fresh-client behavior.

Static and hermetic checks do not prove live YouTube, Claude Code, or Codex
behavior.

## Deferred

Not implemented: hosted web UI, browser extension, hosted API, writable MCP,
vector or hybrid retrieval, graph database, automatic acquisition, and ranking
self-learning. See `ROADMAP.md` for measured triggers.
